_comment: Official MCP servers for the deeds-web-app stack. Lives ALONGSIDE .vscode/mcp.json (which holds the custom multicore mcpClients setup). Claude Code reads both. Each entry below spawns an official server lazily via npx/uvx — no global install required. All entries default to read-only roles where supported. Operator overrides via env vars before launching Claude Code.

neo4j._purpose: Graph queries — IMPORTS / SIMILAR_TOPOLOGY / BELONGS_TO_CLUSTER. Read-only via NEO4J_READ_ONLY=true.

qdrant._purpose: Vector search across codebase_chunks_768 + evidence_items + summary_lenses_768. Search-only role — no upserts.

postgres._purpose: Read-only Postgres queries. CRITICAL: connect with a role that has SELECT-only on the target schemas (create dedicated `claude_readonly` user — do NOT use legal_admin).

redis._purpose: Read-only Redis introspection (KEYS / GET / TYPE only). Use the official Redis MCP with read-only ACL user.

obsidian._purpose: Filesystem-native Obsidian vault access — reads docs/obsidian-vault. mcpvault community server.

ts-lsp._purpose: TypeScript Language Server Protocol bridge — go-to-definition / find-references / hover / type info. Uses the @typescript/native-preview already in deps.

context7._purpose: Hosted Upstash Context7 MCP — fetches up-to-date library docs by name (e.g. get-library-docs(name='svelte', topic='runes')). Third lane in the docs-fetching cascade: TS LSP (in-process, free) → readability crawler (existing web-research-crawler.ts, free) → Context7 (hosted, free tier). Use Context7 when LSP doesn't expose a package's docs AND the docs site is JS-rendered so direct fetch returns empty HTML. Free tier: 100 requests/day. Set CONTEXT7_API_KEY env var for higher tiers.

_notes: Verify each server one at a time with `mcporter list` before enabling all six.
Postgres + Redis MUST use dedicated read-only roles (claude_readonly). Never reuse legal_admin / app credentials.
Neo4j NEO4J_READ_ONLY=true is the official server's flag — verify with the version you install.

When all SEVEN are mounted, Claude has 7 official + ~74 custom (54 inline + 20 registry-side from src/mcp/*_tools.ts) = ~81 tool surface area. Token cost on tools/list is significant — keep the connection long-lived to amortize.
Context7 is hosted (Upstash) — calls leave the operator's machine. The other six servers run locally. Reflect this in any privacy-sensitive workflow.

Docs-fetching cascade order (per synthesis-loop plan §F): TS LSP (local, in-process) → web-research-crawler.ts readability extractor (local, fetches static HTML) → Context7 (hosted, JS-rendered SPAs). Local lanes win; Context7 is the fallback.
Existing custom MCP at .vscode/mcp.json (mcp-multicore-server.mjs) stays untouched — it serves the SvelteKit dev server's auto-solve loop, not Claude Code itself.
